```{r ROPE analysis, echo=FALSE}


####ROPE + HDI DECISION RULE ANALYSIS####

# Evaluate the strength of evidence for key interaction parameters
# (Age × Time of Day, Age × Format) using:
#   ROPE (Region of Practical Equivalence)
#   HDI (Highest Density Interval)
#   Directional posterior probabilities
#
# This script follows method of Kruschke (2018) and Kruschke & Liddell (2018).

#Note ROPE analysis was run on the HPC so model output were loaded back in via HPC directory, can also be run locally, just change path /directory for where model output path is

#Model one: Time of day, age, format
# Load fitted hierarchical model

fit_FormatToD_mixModel <- readRDS(
  file.path(savemodel_output_path, "FormatToD_mixModel_final.rds"))

# Extract posterior draws into a dataframe
post_ToDExp_draws <- as_draws_df(fit_FormatToD_mixModel)

# Define ROPEs (Justifcation for ROPES detailed in manuscript) for kappa and theta
#these reflect smallest effect sizes considered piratically meaningful
delta_kappa <- 0.10
rope_kappa  <- c(-delta_kappa, delta_kappa)

delta_theta <- 0.35
rope_theta  <- c(-delta_theta, delta_theta)

# Parameters of interest: Age and Time of Day interaction and Age and Experiment Format Interaction terms for theta and kappa
params <- list(
  theta_tod = list(par = "b_theta1_AgeGroupOld:ToD_ConditionNight", rope = rope_theta),
  theta_format = list(par = "b_theta1_AgeGroupOld:formatNon_Video", rope = rope_theta),
  kappa_tod = list(par = "b_kappa1_AgeGroupOld:ToD_ConditionNight", rope = rope_kappa),
  kappa_format = list(par = "b_kappa1_AgeGroupOld:formatNon_Video", rope = rope_kappa)
)

#build a function that summarises posterior evidence for each parameter
summarise_parameter <- function(draws, rope, ci = 0.95) {
  #Calculate Highest Density Interval
  h <- bayestestR::hdi(draws, ci = ci)
  
  data.frame(
    posterior_mean = mean(draws),
    #HDI bounds
    hdi_low  = h$CI_low,
    hdi_high = h$CI_high,
    
    #Directional Probabilities
    p_positive = mean(draws > 0),
    p_negative = mean(draws < 0),
    
    # Evidence relative to ROPE boundaries
    p_rope         = mean(draws >= rope[1] & draws <= rope[2]),
    p_meaningful   = mean(draws < rope[1] | draws > rope[2]),
    #ROPE bounds
    rope_low       = rope[1],
    rope_high      = rope[2]
  )
}
#loop across parameters and compute ROPE and HDI summaries
ROPE_results <- bind_rows(lapply(names(params), function(nm) {
  par_name <- params[[nm]]$par
  rope_val <- params[[nm]]$rope
  
  draws <- post_ToDExp_draws[[par_name]] #extract draws for parameter
  
  out <- summarise_parameter(draws = draws, rope = rope_val)
  
  out$parameter <- nm
  
  out
})) %>%
  #  Apply HDI-ROPE Decision rule (Kruschke, 2018). See paper for more details on accepting, rejecting null
  mutate(
    decision = case_when(
      # Rule 1: HDI is fully inside ROPE -> Practical equivalence
      hdi_low >= rope_low & hdi_high <= rope_high ~ "Accept Null",
      
      # Rule 2: HDI is fully outside ROPE -> Meaningful effect
      hdi_high < rope_low | hdi_low > rope_high ~ "Reject Null",
      
      # Rule 3: HDI and ROPE overlaps -> Insufficient data to decide/inconclusive
      TRUE ~ "Undecided"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    parameter,
    posterior_mean,
    hdi_low,
    hdi_high,
    p_positive,
    p_negative,
    p_meaningful,
    p_rope,
    rope_low,
    rope_high,
    decision
  )

#view  rope results to see decision
print(ROPE_results)


#save ROPE summary results csv and rds
write.csv(
  ROPE_results,
  file = file.path(savemodel_output_path, "posterior_ROPE_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  ROPE_results, file=file.path(savemodel_output_path, "posterior_ROPE_summary.rds")
)

```


```{r Plotting ROPE + HDI Posterior, echo=FALSE}


#visualise posterior distributions for interaction parameters: summary of Bayesian evidence
# (Age × Time-of-Day, Age × Format)
#   ROPE shading (Region of Practical Equivalence)
#   95% HDI (Highest Density Interval)
#   Posterior mean
#

#Define parameters and ROPEs

params <- list(
  theta_tod = list(
    name = "b_theta1_AgeGroupOld:ToD_ConditionNight",
    rope = c(-0.35, 0.35),
    label = "A: Memory Probability (θ₁)\nAge × Time-of-Day "
  ),
  theta_format = list(
    name = "b_theta1_AgeGroupOld:formatNon_Video",
    rope = c(-0.35, 0.35),
    label = "B: Memory Probability (θ₁)\nAge × Format "
  ),
  kappa_tod = list(
    name = "b_kappa1_AgeGroupOld:ToD_ConditionNight",
    rope = c(-0.10, 0.10),
    label = "C: Precision (κ₁)\nAge × Time-of-Day"
  ),
  kappa_format = list(
    name = "b_kappa1_AgeGroupOld:formatNon_Video",
    rope = c(-0.10, 0.10),
    label = "D: Precision (κ₁)\nAge × Format"
  )
)

# Create Posterior dataframe with HDIs

posterior_df <- map_df(names(params), function(p) {
  par_info <- params[[p]]
  draws <- post_ToDExp_draws[[par_info$name]]
  
  h <- hdi(draws, ci = 0.95)
  
  tibble(
    parameter = par_info$label,
    value = draws,
    rope_low = par_info$rope[1],
    rope_high = par_info$rope[2],
    hdi_low = h$CI_low,
    hdi_high = h$CI_high,
    mean = mean(draws)
  )
})

# Create row-by-row layout sorting
posterior_df$parameter <- factor(posterior_df$parameter, levels = map_chr(params, ~ .x$label))

# Plot: posterior density + HDI + ROPE

ROPEHDI <- ggplot(posterior_df, aes(x = value)) +
  # ROPE shading
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = rope_low,
      xmax = rope_high,
      ymin = 0,
      ymax = Inf,
      fill = "ROPE\n(Region of Practical Equivalence)"
    ),
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  # posterior density curve
  geom_density(fill = "skyblue",
               alpha = 0.4,
               colour = "skyblue4") +
  # HDI line at y = 0
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = hdi_low,
      xend = hdi_high,
      y = 0,
      yend = 0,
      colour = "95% HDI\n(Highest Density Interval)"
    ),
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  # Posterior mean (dashed verticle line)
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean),
             colour = "blue",
             linetype = "dashed") +
  
  facet_wrap( ~ parameter, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  # Manual scale definitions
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("ROPE\n(Region of Practical Equivalence)" = "orange")
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = NULL,
                      values = c("95% HDI\n(Highest Density Interval)" = "blue")) +
  labs(x = "Posterior value", y = "Density", title = "Posterior Distributions with 95% HDIs and ROPEs") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "vertical"
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 2)),
         fill = guide_legend(order = 2))

#save ROPE HDI Plot
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(savemodel_output_path,"ROPHDIPlot.jpeg"),
  plot = ROPEHDI ,
  width = 12,
  height = 6
)

```


```{r Supplementary ROPE analysis: using ETI not HDI, echo=FALSE}


#This Sensitivity analysis was conducted in which equal-tailed intervals (ETIs) were used in the ROPE decision framework
#and compared to results using HDIs because of possible transformation incoherence (Etz et al., 2024).

#Analysis repeats same ROPE analysis above except decision rule is using  ETIs instead to HDIs to confirm robustness of conclusions 
#(See Etz et al., 2024 and Manuscript for more details for sensitivity analysis)


# Load fitted model
fit_FormatToD_mixModel <- readRDS(
  file.path(savemodel_output_path, "FormatToD_mixModel_final.rds")
)

# Extract posterior draws
post_ToDExp_draws <- as_draws_df(fit_FormatToD_mixModel)

# Define ROPEs (Same used as above)
delta_kappa <- 0.10
rope_kappa  <- c(-delta_kappa, delta_kappa)

delta_theta <- 0.35
rope_theta  <- c(-delta_theta, delta_theta)

# Parameters of interest
params <- list(
  theta_tod = list(par = "b_theta1_AgeGroupOld:ToD_ConditionNight", rope = rope_theta),
  theta_format = list(par = "b_theta1_AgeGroupOld:formatNon_Video", rope = rope_theta),
  kappa_tod = list(par = "b_kappa1_AgeGroupOld:ToD_ConditionNight", rope = rope_kappa),
  kappa_format = list(par = "b_kappa1_AgeGroupOld:formatNon_Video", rope = rope_kappa)
)

summarise_parameter <- function(draws, rope, ci = 0.95) {
  #compute Equal-Tailed-Interval (ETI)
  # Uses the coherent quantile interval suggested by Etz et al. (2024)
  h <- bayestestR::eti(draws, ci = ci)
  
  data.frame(
    posterior_mean = mean(draws),
    
    #define ETI bounds
    eti_low  = h$CI_low,
    eti_high = h$CI_high,
    
    #Directional Probabilities
    p_positive = mean(draws > 0),
    p_negative = mean(draws < 0),
    
    # Evidence relative to ROPE boundaries
    p_rope         = mean(draws >= rope[1] & draws <= rope[2]),
    p_meaningful   = mean(draws < rope[1] | draws > rope[2]),
    #ROPE boundaries
    rope_low       = rope[1],
    rope_high      = rope[2]
  )
}
#loop across parameters and compute ETI-based ROPE summaries
ROPE_results_V2 <- bind_rows(lapply(names(params), function(nm) {
  par_name <- params[[nm]]$par
  rope_val <- params[[nm]]$rope
  
  draws <- post_ToDExp_draws[[par_name]]
  
  out <- summarise_parameter(draws = draws, rope = rope_val)
  
  out$parameter <- nm
  
  out
})) %>%
  #  ETI-ROPE Decision Rule
  mutate(
    decision = case_when(
      # Rule 1: ETI is completely inside ROPE -> Practical equivalence
      eti_low >= rope_low & eti_high <= rope_high ~ "Accept Null",
      
      # Rule 2: ETI is completely outside ROPE -> Meaningful effect
      eti_high < rope_low | eti_low > rope_high ~ "Reject Null",
      
      # Rule 3: ETI and ROPE overlap -> Insufficient data to decide/Inconclusive
      TRUE ~ "Undecided"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    parameter,
    posterior_mean,
    eti_low,
    eti_high,
    p_positive,
    p_negative,
    p_meaningful,
    p_rope,
    rope_low,
    rope_high,
    decision
  )

#view results
print(ROPE_results_V2)


#save ROPE ETI summary results csv and rds
write.csv(
  ROPE_results,
  file = file.path(savemodel_output_path, "posterior_ROPE2_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  ROPE_results, file=file.path(savemodel_output_path, "posterior_ROPE2_summary.rds")
)
```
